name: Anthropic SDK (no framework)
summary: The baseline: the official Python SDK's tool runner loops over MCP tools converted with anthropic.lib.tools.mcp. No agent framework at all.
notes: anthropic 2.6 tool_runner over MCP tools converted with anthropic.lib.tools.mcp.async_mcp_tool (mcp 2.x Client) plus one @beta_async_tool. By default the tool runner uses the Message Threads beta (each request carries thread.previous_message_id and only the new messages); that request is rejected through a LiteLLM gateway ("unexpected tool_use_id"), so the adapter passes thread=False and sends the full history like every other framework. Sends the system prompt verbatim, no sampling params, no tool_choice, no prompt caching.
